reviews.comment:
Estoy muy conforme con el servicio ya estuve  otra ves y los que atienden son personas cordiales y lo que es cafeteria  tambien y se nota  quetodo es fresco verdad un gusto  para a tomar un cafe y comer algo  solo un detalle en verano..arian falta mas surtidores  para el verano lasmedia lunas so ricas pero pebetes jamon y queso son espetaculares

(Translated by Google)
I'm very happy with the service. I've been back before, and the staff are friendly. The cafeteria is great too, and you can tell everything is fresh. It's a pleasure to stop for a coffee and a bite to eat. Just one thing: in the summer, they need more water dispensers. The croissants are delicious, but the ham and cheese sandwiches are spectacular.
